class.name: HEGoAssetAgent
class.brief_description: Holds the HDAs one Godot node owns, and does the fiddly parts of driving them.

method.name: task
method.description:
Waits for [param task] and returns its result, or [code]null[/code] if it failed.
[code]null[/code] is not a general failure signal: a task that legitimately did nothing also completes with null, which is what HEGo returns for work it could skip. It does mean failure after [code]cook()[/code], which returns 0 when it succeeds and fails its task when Houdini rejects it.

method.name: asset
method.description:
The asset node for [param operator_name], created on first use and reused afterwards.
Reusing it is what keeps the Houdini node id valid between cooks. [param label] names it for the bottom panel and defaults to the operator without its table.

method.name: instantiate
method.description:
Makes [param asset] exist in Houdini. False when it could not be created.
Pushes the owner's transform when it is spatial, and restores [param stashed_parameters] only when this call is what created the Houdini node. That condition is the subtle part: restoring on every cook would undo whatever the user has since changed in the panel.
Returns false on a license failure, which Houdini reports by completing successfully with an id of -1 rather than by failing. An unknown operator name is not caught here, because Houdini hands back a valid id for one; the cook is what rejects it.
A failed preset restore releases the new instance so the next cook can retry the saved parameters. With [param strict], a failed transform also stops instantiation.

method.name: save_parameters
method.description: The asset's current parameters, as a blob to store on the node so they survive a session restart and a scene reload. Empty when they could not be read.

method.name: rebuild_asset
method.description: Reloads the library that supplies [param previous], replaces its instance and clears its input chains. Look up the replacement with [method asset] and run the host's usual cook to upload the current Godot inputs. Live parameters are captured before reloading. Before the first cook the replacement uses [param stashed_parameters].

method.name: sync_inputs
method.description:
Feeds [param asset] the scene nodes and textures stored in the owner's input stash.
Every HDA input goes through a merge node, because one Houdini input can combine several Godot nodes, and the input nodes are kept between cooks so unchanged geometry is not re-sent. [param skip_indices] leaves inputs alone that something else fills, which is how an input fed by another HDA survives.
[param cook] is the dictionary a host's [HEGoCookExtension]s share, and its [code]errors[/code] collects what went wrong. An input an [HEGoInputHandler] could not send always counts as an error. When [code]strict[/code] is true, so does any input that is missing, incompatible or fails to upload, rather than being skipped with a warning. Returns false when the input names could not be read or any error was recorded.

method.name: set_input
method.description:
Points SOP input [param index] at [param sources]. Accepts a [Node], [NodePath], path string, [Texture2D], or an array combining them. A texture uses linear encoding by default. For sRGB color, pass [code]{"texture": texture, "encoding": HEGoTextureInputNode.ENCODING_SRGB}[/code]. Each texture contributes one point with the string attribute [code]hego_cop_path[/code]. Texture points follow scene inputs in the order supplied.
Writes to the same stash the panel's Inputs pane writes to, so an exported property and the panel agree rather than fighting.

method.name: show_in_panel
method.description:
Shows only [param labels] in the bottom panel, in that order.
The default is every asset this node has made, in creation order. A tool with several stages usually wants to say which of them a user should see, and put the one they are working on first. Pass an empty array to go back to showing all of them.

method.name: highlight
method.description:
Makes the panel open [param label]'s section and scroll to it on the next rebuild.
A recook rebuilds the panel, so a tool that moves the user on to its next stage can point them at it rather than leaving them to find it. Pass an empty string to highlight nothing.

method.name: panel_assets
method.description:
The assets the bottom panel should show, in order, as the panel wants them.
Return this straight from a node's [code]hego_get_panel_assets()[/code]. Entries are [code]{ "label", "asset", "highlight" }[/code]; a label in [member panel_labels] that names no asset is skipped.

method.name: can_release
method.description: Whether the loaded HEGo binary can delete nodes from the session, which [method release] needs. Binaries older than [method HEGoBaseNode.delete_node] cannot.

method.name: release
method.description:
Deletes every Houdini node this agent made - the HDAs, and the merge and input nodes behind their inputs - and forgets them. True when all of them are gone.
Houdini keeps a node's cooked geometry, and HEGo a copy of its output, for as long as the node exists, so a host that cooks a large asset once and keeps the result as Godot nodes can let them go. The next cook creates everything again: the HDA from the owner's stashed parameters and the inputs by a full upload. The bottom panel shows no parameters for a released host until then.
Returns false, and deletes nothing, when [method can_release] is false.

method.name: output_context
method.description:
Fetches what [param asset]'s cook produced and wraps it for the output handlers.
Needed by anything in the output library: [method HEGoMeshOutput.fetch_meshes], [method HEGoMultiMeshOutput.setup_multimesh], and a handler's own [code]handle(context)[/code].
[param cook] becomes the context's [member HEGoOutputContext.cook_state].

members.member: The node these assets belong to.
Every asset this node has made, keyed by label, in creation order. The bottom panel reads this to know what to show and what to call each section.
Labels the bottom panel shows, in the order it shows them. Empty means every asset, in creation order. Set it with [method show_in_panel].
Label of the asset the panel opens and scrolls to after a rebuild, or empty for none. Set it with [method highlight].
